fact: Access Now's #KeepItOn report lists Togo among African states with a 2025 internet shutdown, described as protest throttling; it does not say what was throttled, where, who ordered it or when it ended.

fact: CIPESA says Togo had a three-day internet shutdown during the 2017 protests, which the ECOWAS Community Court of Justice later found violated freedom of expression because national law did not authorise it, and it ordered compensation to the applicants.
